title: 'Super creepy': Woman spooked by happenings after visit with Annabelle in Salem
excerpt: Kayla Jackson of Saugus described a series of incidents since her encounter with the infamous doll in a viral TikTok post.
content:
A Massachusetts woman is feeling haunted after an encounter with the infamous Annabelle doll in Salem.

Kayla Jackson of Saugus says her visit didn't exactly end when she left the Warren Museum, and the strange coincidences she's reporting have hundreds of thousands watching online.

There was a flickering flashlight, and there was a glitching radio, but Jackson says the moment that really freaked her out was waiting for her in her bedroom.

"I came up these steps right here, and I stopped right about here when I started seeing the feathers, and my boyfriend was right behind me, and I was like, 'What is this? What is this?' And then I turned this corner, and right there was the dead bird, and I immediately screamed and turned away," she told NBC10 Boston Monday. "I thought maybe the cat had brought it inside, but we checked all of the windows, and everything was closed and locked up."

The doll, believed by many to be haunted, will be on display in Witch City beginning this summer.

Her TikTok post about it went viral, because two days earlier, she had visited Annabelle.

"My friend and I both had a flashlight, and let's just say hers was flickering the entire time," Jackson said on TikTok.

And she says the weird stuff started before she even left.

Then, they walked into Annabelle's room.

"The room was noticeably colder the minute that we stepped in," she said in her video.

Two days after seeing Annabelle, the bird showed up. Then, one more thing she couldn't explain: The radio glitching on a car ride home from dinner with a friend.

"I had gotten out of the car, and she called me, and she was like, 'The music is completely fine now,' and that's when I knew I had to make a video, because the coincidences were just too much," Jackson said.

That's when this story got even weirder.

After seeing Jackson's video, another woman shared what she says happened after seeing the doll.

"Wednesday night, I was awoken by a huge crash sound that sounded like our dishes fell off the dish rack," @somegirlsam said on TikTok. "Only problem is, we had no dishes on the dishrack."

Jackson added that her mom told her a bird in the house is an Italian omen.

"I looked it up, and it said 'impending danger or disaster,' so I was like, 'That's super creepy,'" she said.

Jackson isn't claiming she can prove Annabelle had anything to do with this. But she says her dad wasn't taking any chances. After the bird showed up, he saged the house.
